title: a master material with parameters, an instance that overrides them, compiled and applied
proves: author a material graph, instance it, read the parameter values back, and see it on a mesh

steps.label: primitive puerts_material_build is NOT usable
steps.detail: NEW: not registered, and no legacy tool in the inventory covers it either
steps.why: author a UMaterial graph: expression nodes, named scalar/vector/texture parameters, and the base-colour, emissive, roughness and normal connections. Without it there is no parent material to instance, so the material slice cannot start from a prompt. Lane I states this will not exist in that lane, and lane B recorded material graph structure as a platform gap. The nearest registered tool, puerts_sky_shader_create, builds one specific hard-coded sky material

steps.label: 1. look for an existing master material to instance instead
1. some material exists to act as a parent
1. this is a degraded path, not the slice
steps.detail: instancing whatever material happens to exist proves the instance tool, not the prompt. The prompt asked for a material with named parameters, and a parent nobody authored has no guarantee of carrying any.

steps.detail: PRESENT BUT FAILING: ["No asset was found at '/Game/MCPGenerated/MI_SliceBeacon.MI_SliceBeacon'."]

steps.label: primitive puerts_texture_import is NOT usable
steps.detail: NEW: not registered, and no legacy tool in the inventory covers it either
steps.why: import or generate a UTexture2D so a texture parameter can be set. puerts_material_instance_build accepts a textures map and nothing in the catalog can produce a texture to put in it; docs/GAP_AUDIT-2026-07-29.md records no texture tools at all

steps.label: 4. put the instance on a mesh through a component template property
steps.detail: PRESENT BUT FAILING: ["Component 'Body' property 'OverrideMaterials': element 0: asset '/Game/MCPGenerated/MI_SliceBeacon.MI_SliceBeacon' could not be loaded."]

steps.label: 5. capture the viewport so the material can be judged by eye
steps.detail: PRESENT BUT FAILING: ["No requested actors were found for viewport capture."]

steps.label: 6. shader compilation is not observable
steps.detail: no registered tool reports whether the shader compiler has finished, so a screenshot taken immediately after a material change can legitimately show the default checkerboard. Lane I reports compile result inside the instance build response, which covers the instance but not the shader map.
